analysis:
Both units are CHANGELOG.md text only, so the only changed content is documentation. Nothing executable or configurable changes, and no new attack surface is introduced by the diff itself. I reviewed the head text for statements that would affect the threat model.

The PR's one added entry is the coordinator schema migration note at the top (lines 3-6). It describes numbered goose migrations, a 3s lock timeout with up to three retries, and an advisory lock for coordinators that start together. The changelog also records a checked-in schema.sql. The underlying migration code is not in the supplied units, so the actual migration behavior is a coverage limit rather than a verified fact. A later pass should check the unsupplied code for these points: fail-closed boot behavior on migration failure, advisory-lock handling, and no schema drift on payment_ledger (A-009) or the App Attest and qualification tables (A-015 to A-017).

The existing changelog entries touch these areas, but I cannot confirm any of them from this diff:
- SSD cache TTL of 30 minutes under T-041 / SEC-035, already re-accepted in the canonical definition.
- Removal of the unauthenticated /v1/provider/earnings lookup under T-031.
- Fail-closed attestation challenges.
- App Attest protocol 3 only (TB-011, T-052 to T-058).

The changelog claims of removal and fail-closed behavior match the canonical threat model. I did not independently check them against source.

I report no findings. Fully assessing the schema-migration claim needs the migration source and tests, which were not supplied.
